content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">01 / WELCOME TO BAWBAGS</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.Green>BUILD. TAME. EXPLORE.</>

<TextStyle.White>Your home on the ARK.</>
<TextStyle.White>A PvE cluster for builders, breeders</>
<TextStyle.White>and survivors who enjoy the journey.</>

<TextStyle.White>Adventure together. Make it yours.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">02 / CLUSTER AT A GLANCE</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.Yellow>2x XP   /   3x HARVESTING</>
<TextStyle.Green>5x TAMING   /   10x MATURATION</>

<TextStyle.White>Seven maps. One Bawbags community.</>
<TextStyle.White>Find progression and breeding details</>
<TextStyle.White>in the Server Settings tab.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">03 / YOUR TIME. YOUR REWARDS.</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.Yellow>+5 TOKENS / 10 MINUTES</>

<TextStyle.White>Earn automatically through active play.</>
<TextStyle.White>Use your balance in the Reward Shop.</>

<TextStyle.Green>Explore Tokens for earning details.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">04 / SURVIVOR SHORTCUTS</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>[ TOKENS ]  Earning and balances</>
<TextStyle.White>[ REWARD SHOP ]  Creatures and delivery</>
<TextStyle.White>[ SETTINGS ]  Rates and breeding</>
<TextStyle.White>[ COMMUNITY ]  Maps and support</>

<TextStyle.Green>F1 / Open this guide anytime</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">PLAY. EARN. SPEND.</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Tokens are the currency used in the Bawbags Reward Shop.</>

<TextStyle.White>Earn 5 tokens automatically for every 10 minutes of active play.</>

<TextStyle.Yellow>10 minutes = 5 tokens</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>1 hour = 30 tokens</>

<TextStyle.White>Keep exploring, building and taming while your playtime earns rewards. Spend your tokens when you find something you want.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">USING YOUR TOKENS</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Open the Reward Shop using the button below. Sign in with the account linked to your survivor to view your balance and purchases.</>

<TextStyle.White>Earned and purchased tokens use the same shop prices.</>

<TextStyle.White>Buying tokens is optional:</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>100 tokens = GBP 1</>

<TextStyle.White>Examples:</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>Spino: 900 tokens</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>TEK Giga: 1,500 tokens</>

<TextStyle.White>For a balance or purchase issue, contact the team on Discord.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">CHOOSE YOUR NEXT CREATURE</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Browse the dinosaur catalogue on our website, then open a listing to see its token price and delivery details.</>

<TextStyle.Yellow>1. Open Reward Shop below.</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>2. Sign in and check your token balance.</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>3. Select your creature and review the listing.</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>4. Follow the shop checkout and delivery instructions.</>

<TextStyle.White>There are no dinosaur purchase limits, player-level requirements or progression unlocks.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">DINOSAUR DELIVERY</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.White>Shop creatures are delivered inside Pelayori's Cryo Storage cryopods.</>

<TextStyle.White>Levels are based on the species' obtainable server maximum plus its applicable taming bonus. Special-tame and egg species can differ.</>

<TextStyle.White>Creatures are supplied breedable where the species supports breeding. Species that cannot naturally breed remain exceptions.</>

<TextStyle.White>There is no shop restriction requiring delivery on a particular map.</>

<TextStyle.White>Keep your purchase details if you need help with delivery.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">01 / PROGRESSION</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.Yellow>2x / EXPERIENCE</>
<TextStyle.Green>3x / RESOURCE HARVESTING</>
<TextStyle.Green>5x / TAMING SPEED</>

<TextStyle.White>PvE gameplay across the cluster.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">02 / CREATURE LEVELS</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.Yellow>180 / STANDARD WILD MAX</>

<TextStyle.White>Special species have their own ranges.</>
<TextStyle.White>Shop levels include the applicable</>
<TextStyle.White>taming bonus for that species.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">03 / BREEDING</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.Green>10x / BABY MATURATION</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>20x / EGG HATCHING</>

<TextStyle.White>0.1x standard mating interval.</>
<TextStyle.White>More time raising your next generation.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">04 / IMPRINTING</>
content.text:
<TextStyle.Green>0.1x / CUDDLE INTERVAL</>
<TextStyle.Yellow>5x / IMPRINT AMOUNT</>

<TextStyle.White>Multipliers apply to server settings.</>
<TextStyle.White>This page is an information guide.</>
